answer_1.quote: The knowledge update task needs to update only the answers of x i itself and its equivalent domain N (x i ) without changing the answers of other out-of-scope knowledge.

answer_2.quote: Specifically, the quality of knowledge updating has the following three evaluation indicators: (1) Reliability is measured as the average accuracy on the new knowledge for the updated model f θ * ... (2) Generalization means the new model f θ * should also updated the equivalent neighbour N (x i ) ... It is evaluated by the average accuracy ... (3) Locality means the updated model f θ * should not change the output of the irrelevant examples ... evaluated by the rate at which the updated model f θ * 's predictions are unchanged as the pre-update f θ model.
